title: OpenAI Says Staffer Arrested for Hidden Recording Device in Office
description: An employee at OpenAI was arrested and charged with using a hidden recording device in one of the company’s San Francisco offices, according to statements from the artificial intelligence company and the US Justice Department.

title: Anthropic Asks Appeals Court to Rehear Fight Over Security Risk
description: Anthropic PBC urged the federal appeals court in Washington to revisit its decision upholding the Trump administration’s designation of the artificial intelligence company as a supply-chain risk to US national security.

title: Microsoft AI Focused Data Center Plan to Add 26 Gigawatts of Compute
description: Shortages forced the company to turn away some AI and cloud business. Now it’s planning for 38 gigawatts of data center capacity to meet demand.
